rationale: The pain is real but extremely narrow: only companies simultaneously running custom-built chatbots AND Salesforce Service Cloud AND attempting human-agent handover face this exact integration decision. A single forum signal with no corroborating paid-tool demand, no competitor pricing evidence, and no volume of complaints across StackExchange, GitHub, or Trailblazer Community is insufficient to meet the pass threshold of 5 distinct pain quotes and 1 willingness-to-pay signal. The engineering cost is real but the addressable population is too small and dispersed to justify promotion.
